Assemble the comparison table and make the adequacy call

Source: R/callComparisons.R
callComparisons.Rd

Merges the layer metrics into one tidy table, one row per comparison, and assigns each comparison a call: Invalid (the contrast is not estimable, or too few samples per group), Caution (estimable but the condition is confounded with a covariate, cell-count imbalance tracks the condition under DESeq2 (whose FDR control it breaks; with edgeR or voom the imbalance is reported in the reason but does not change the call), or a subtype shift within the cluster would by itself make enough genes look DE; see assessComposition()), Underpowered (valid but the expected recall at the target effect is below thresholds$sensitivity, or too few testable genes), or Adequate. Severity order is Invalid > Caution > Underpowered > Adequate; the reason column lists every flag so the single call never hides a second problem.

Usage

callComparisons(
  design,
  pseudobulk,
  variance,
  sensitivity,
  thresholds = defaultThresholds(),
  composition = NULL
)

Arguments

design, pseudobulk, variance, sensitivity

The outputs of assessDesign(), assessPseudobulk(), estimateVariance() (its $summary) and estimateSensitivity().

thresholds

A list from defaultThresholds().

composition

Optional $summary of assessComposition(). NULL (default) skips the composition columns and flag.

Value

A S4Vectors::DataFrame, one row per comparison, with all metrics, the call and a reason string.

Examples

sce <- readRDS(system.file("extdata", "example_sce.rds", package = "seny"))
x <- pbSetup(sce, sample = "donor", group = "condition",
             annotations = "cell_type", thetaReps = 0)
variance <- estimateVariance(x)
#> calcNormFactors has been renamed to normLibSizes
#> calcNormFactors has been renamed to normLibSizes
#> calcNormFactors has been renamed to normLibSizes
sens <- estimateSensitivity(variance, targetLFC = 1)
res <- callComparisons(assessDesign(x), assessPseudobulk(x), variance$summary, sens)
res[, c("comparison", "call", "reason")]
#> DataFrame with 3 rows and 3 columns
#>              comparison         call                 reason
#>             <character>     <factor>            <character>
#> 1 cell_type:CD4T:B_vs_A Adequate                   adequate
#> 2 cell_type:CD8T:B_vs_A Adequate     cell-count imbalance..
#> 3   cell_type:NK:B_vs_A Underpowered underpowered (expect..
